dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000sicu](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000sicu) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 35.536 depth occurred on May 05 2026 54km S of Waikabubak. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -10.1135 longitude 119.3245. It impacted 77780 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
